method: Seed-paired means; two-sided Student t95 intervals with seed as independent replicate; no episode pseudoreplication.

manifest.factorial: A=adaptive partitions, P=predictor, Q=query allocator, S=program selection. Off=frozen initialization.
manifest.resourceLaw: Correct route+4; incorrect-4; hold/absent0; query costs1 (shift3). Comparison work reported separately.
manifest.schedule: Primitive warmup; program learning starts afterward. Frozen tests. Skipped-query arrivals audited after action.
manifest.status: Saved before test results. Pilot is development data; campaign confirms this fixed protocol.

factorial.definition: k-factor alternating sum of 2^k marginal cell means; remaining factors equally averaged. Main effects=on minus off; AS=difference of differences; APQS=fourth-order cell contrast.

encodingParity.scope: Actions/query decisions plus scalar outcomes/work counts/model footprint and learned native graph digest when supplied. Not cross-world carrier identity; private fixture encoding changes only.
